messages:
Aisha Khan: okay this is ridiculous but my ficus decided to sprout right next to the router and now the router is basically living in foliage :seedling: :wifi:
Liam O'Connor: pics or it didn't happen 😂
Aisha Khan: uploading... (attached: IMG_20260322_1.jpg) router lights peeking out like a techno-gnome
Priya Patel: hilarious. did you run a speedtest after putting the plant there? plants are terrible network engineers :joy:
Aisha Khan: ran one before and after — negligible difference but the cable routing is a nightmare. before: 120/18, after: 118/17 (mbps) 
Jordan Miller: meanwhile my solution was duct-taping the AP to the curtain rod and now the cat treats it as a jungle gym :sob: :cat2:
Liam O'Connor: pro tip: try elevating it by ~1ft if you can. I used an ikea spice rack behind the shelf and got +10Mbps at the desk.
Priya Patel: if anyone wants the quick speedtest command: ```speedtest-cli --simple``` I pipe to head to grab ping/download/upload
Aisha Khan: thx — ran that just now, ping 14 ms, download 118.3 Mbits/s, upload 17.1 Mbits/s
InternetBot: ISP status check: No widespread outages reported in your area. (probe id: 8e3f)
Jordan Miller: still, the wallpaper aesthetic is *chef's kiss* — router peeking through leaves is peak WFH content :thumbsup:
Liam O'Connor: vote: should we have a tiny 'WFH setups' channel for these or keep clogging #random? :thinking_face:
Priya Patel: +1 for a dedicated channel. also 100% for more plant-router photos :heart:
Aisha Khan: if we start a channel I'm claiming the ficus thread as canonical :raised_hands:
Liam O'Connor: noted. creating channel when 3 people react with :seedling:
Priya Patel: reacting now :seedling: 
Jordan Miller: :seedling:
Aisha Khan: :seedling: :grin:
Liam O'Connor: ok that's a win. moving on to router placement experiments next week? science lab at Liam's house :lab_coat:
Priya Patel: I'll bring snacks (and more cable ties)
Aisha Khan: deal. also does anyone have a recommendation for a zip-tie friendly wall mount? mine is a mistake waiting to happen
Jordan Miller: amazon has a 5-pack of router wall mounts for $9. link: https://a.co/example (cheap but works)
Liam O'Connor: thanks, y'all. this thread made my afternoon. :sun_with_face:
